title: LPM: a small model as a function call, performance and results so far
summary: LPM is a Rust engine that runs a small language model on the GPU as a primitive you call from a program. Its WGSL shaders run unchanged on native Metal and in Chrome WebGPU. This page reports what I measured in the first three milestones, the eight lessons that cost time getting there, and which numbers were taken on a busy machine.
